scope: The eight data pages of one locally authored, uncompressed AC1024 DWG that ODA File Converter 27.1 converted successfully. This is not a general verdict for compressed pages or other producers.
source: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 4.6 describes the 32-byte data-page header and its +0x0c decompressed page-size field. The page map records the physical page extent.
finding: The unmodified public dwg-verifier at commit 5a7dc5c6790cd8fece1494c710585019a253dbba reports eight T1.page.header discrepancies because it requires those two different sizes to be equal. The generated uncompressed pages have +0x0c equal to payload and maximum logical page size, and page-map extents exactly 32 bytes larger. Two AppInfo pages are 128 logical/160 physical bytes; six pages are 29696 logical/29728 physical bytes.
independentEvidence: ODA produced a DXF without an error file from this exact DWG and its output retained the two layers' Global material and Normal plot-style links. LibreDWG 0.14 independently decoded the same source. Neither observation establishes semantic rendering or plotting behavior.
controlledVerifierProbe: In a temporary copy only, add the single uncompressed-page alternative page_size == section.max_page_size and physical_extent == 32 + page_size. The otherwise unchanged verifier reports zero findings for the generated DWG and for two ODA-generated AC1024 controls. This localized modification is an explanatory experiment, not an independent verifier release or a basis for a general support claim.
limits: This resolves the reported mismatch for the witnessed uncompressed profile only. ODA-generated compressed pages use a different observed +0x0c relationship; their interpretation and other version profiles are separate. No verifier code or DWG/DXF fixture was committed, and no support claim or phase gate was promoted.
